title: ADL H.E.A.T. Map — U.S. incident evidence layer
official_access_note: ADL states that H.E.A.T. Map users can access and download raw incident data. This project's refresh importer accepts a reviewed CSV export.

snapshot.limitation: This committed seed is a historical public mirror of an ADL H.E.A.T. export, not the current monthly ADL download. The renderer and importer are designed for replacement by a fresh official ADL CSV export without changing the map UI.

methodology.display_semantics: Counts represent records in the selected ADL-derived snapshot. They are not a general hate score, crime rate, population-normalized risk measure, or characterization of a state or its residents.
methodology.overlap_rule: One ADL record may carry multiple incident-type labels; the record is counted once in total incident counts.
methodology.missing_geometry: Records without trustworthy coordinates remain eligible for state aggregation when a state is available but are omitted from the point layer.
methodology.source_boundary: ADL classifications are presented as ADL classifications with source and snapshot status visible.

refresh.expected_workflow: Download the CSV from ADL H.E.A.T. Map, then run the importer and review the generated diff before commit.

official_source_verified_claims: The official H.E.A.T. Map provides access to downloadable raw incident data.
